name: publicWeb_getLeaderboard
description: The app's 'Get a Life' leaderboard for one kennel, for a web member (E9.F7.S12): hashers active anywhere in the last year (MAX(HasherKennelMap.DateOfLastRun) within a year) who have run with this kennel, with total, this-year and rolling-year run and haring counts, plus the home kennel's short name for the app's Show Kennels checkbox. The query is copied from HC6.hcapp_getLeaderboard so the two screens agree. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 115, @param NULL); no permission gate beyond a signed-in device. Read-only. A kennel with ExcludeFromLeaderboard = 1 returns no rows.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The browser's HC.Device id (the web member session). No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token signed for this SP (ValidateAppAuth spNumber 115, @param NULL). No SQL default.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: The kennel. No SQL default; an unknown or removed kennel returns the success envelope and no rows.

rowsets.name: AuthErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: On a ValidateAppAuth failure: { success = 0, errorCode, errorType } then the detail at index 1; the SP RETURNs.
Error detail after the AuthErrorEnvelope (errorId, errorType, errorCode, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, errorProc).

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: On success: { success = 1, errorCode = NULL, errorType = NULL }.

rowsets.name: Leaderboard
rowsets.description: On success: one row per qualifying HasherKennelMap row of the kennel (DateOfLastRun set, not a placeholder or anonymous hasher), ORDER BY totalRunCount DESC, DisplayName.

columns.name: isHomeKennel
columns.description: 1 when this kennel is the hasher's HomeKennelId.

columns.name: homeKennelShortName
columns.description: Kennel.KennelShortName of the hasher's home kennel; NULL when none.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.ErrorLog ('<web>', userId, deviceId) then THROW in the CATCH. ValidateAppAuth logs its own failures.

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken and @publicKennelId have no SQL default (line 16). A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs — an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default'). The Next.js client always sends them, so this is latent.

codeSmells.issue: Hasher id compared with kennel id
codeSmells.detail: Line 72 'h.id != k.id' compares a hasher id with a kennel id — copied from hcapp_getLeaderboard. It presumably excludes a kennel's own placeholder hasher (one whose id equals the kennel's), but it reads like a typo; the 'Placeholder user for%' filter on line 73 may already cover it.

Lines 73-74 exclude placeholder and anonymous hashers by matching DisplayName / HashName text. A renamed placeholder would reach the leaderboard. Shared with hcapp_getLeaderboard, so any fix belongs in both — or in one shared view.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
